name: Educate Girls' Vidya programme (The Life You Can Save, 2025)
beneficiaries_note: The location the sheet's bottom line reads (row labels naming India).

missing_data.note: Measured: Educate Girls counts the girls it enrolled and the children taught, and the learning gain is from the randomised evaluation of its own programme, halved for fidelity at scale.

summary: Educate Girls' volunteers find girls who are out of school in villages of Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh and bring them into school, and teach children in grades 3 to 5 remedial reading and maths. The Life You Can Save estimates 5.23 learning-adjusted years of schooling per $100 from Educate Girls' FY 2023-24 costs: a year of school for each girl enrolled who stays, and half the trial's learning gain for each child taught. Our view turns the schooling and learning into later earnings with the site's shared figures; the biggest uncertainties are how much of a childhood learning gain lasts into adult earnings and how many of the girls would have enrolled anyway.

sections.title: Equivalent years of schooling
sections.explainer: Each girl enrolled who completes the year counts as a year of school; each child taught counts as the years of school its learning gain is worth.

sections.title: Learning-adjusted years of schooling
sections.explainer: The World Bank's method: each year is scaled by how much pupils in India learn in a year against an advanced benchmark. The last row is The Life You Can Save's bottom line.

sections.title: From years of schooling back to learning gains
sections.explainer: charityevals' step. Learning-adjusted years of schooling have no shared conversion to the site's scale; the site values learning by the later earnings a gain in reading and maths brings. So the year of school each girl enrolled gets is turned back into the learning it brings, at the sheet's own rate.

sections.title: Costs the sheet leaves out
sections.explainer: charityevals' step: with credit by share of resources on, Educate Girls' staff's pay below market.

sections.title: From learning to later earnings
sections.explainer: charityevals' step: the learning gain raises adult earnings, valued like every income gain on the site, discounted for the wait until the children work.

Share of Gyan ka Pitara's learning gain that wouldn't have happened without Educate Girls
rows.explainer: The sheet credits Educate Girls with the whole gain. Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh run their own foundational-learning missions in the same schools, so some of the gain would have come anyway; our judgment, 80% (50% to 100%).

rows.label: Share of the girls enrolled who wouldn't have enrolled without Educate Girls
rows.explainer: The sheet counts every girl enrolled as Educate Girls' doing. Some of them would have enrolled anyway, through government enrolment drives or a later start; the randomised evaluation of Educate Girls' development impact bond measured a gain in enrolment over control villages well below the gross number enrolled. Our judgment: 60% (30% to 90%).

rows.label: Good of better learning beyond earnings, as a share of the earnings gain
rows.explainer: Schooling and learning bring gains beyond pay: later marriage and first births, healthier children. Our judgment: 10% (0 to 30%) of the earnings gain.
